identity.description: An attacker executes PowerShell to download and run a payload from a rare external IP address. This behavior triggers the ABIOC 'A commonly abused process connected to a rare external host' which detects the unusual network connection by a typical attacker tool.

expected_artifacts.description: PowerShell process started with hidden window

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: PowerShell with Hidden Window
biocs.description: Detects PowerShell process started with hidden window, a common technique for avoiding detection
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe' and action_process_command_line contains '-WindowStyle Hidden'

abiocs.name: Commonly Abused Process Connected to Rare External Host
abiocs.description: Detects a commonly abused process (powershell.exe) making a connection to a rare external IP address
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip in (select ip from rare_ips where count < 5)

xql_queries.name: PowerShell to Rare IP Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip in (select ip from rare_ips where count < 5)
| fields actor_process_image_name, action_remote_ip, timestamp
